references.text: The Lord says that the generation will not pass away before He has fulfilled His promises, which mirrors Jesus' words that the generation will not pass away before all things He has spoken come to pass.
Jesus mentions that some of those standing here will not taste death before they see the Son of Man coming in His kingdom, which underscores the nearness of the events He describes.
Luke gives a parallel statement that this generation will not pass away until all is fulfilled, which strengthens the understanding of Jesus' words in Matthew.
Mark gives a similar statement that this generation will not pass away before all these things have happened, which shows agreement among the Synoptics regarding the timeframe for Jesus' prophecies.
